title: Trade-In / Trade-Up
subtitle: Redesigning the complete trade experience to be more visual, easier to follow, and roughly twice as fast.

evidence.statement: Approximately 60 seconds to approximately 30 seconds in the historical flow comparison
Customer complaints dropped from around 10 per month to nearly none
Newer Trade-In / Trade-Up and Pay by Grade work

quickView.problem: A simple customer goal was buried in an awkward experience with disconnected steps, weak visual guidance, and repeated page reloads.
quickView.evolution: Original redesign → newer Trade-In / Trade-Up → Pay by Grade
quickView.product: A more visual, continuous experience with clearer choices, confirmation, and next steps across the complete site.
quickView.impact: The original redesign reduced an optimistic approximately 60-second flow to approximately 30 seconds, eliminated seven full-page reloads, and reduced customer complaints from around 10 per month to nearly none.
